title: AUDUSD M30 Take Profit 1 (TP1) Extension to Resolve Payout Asymmetry
research_question: Does increasing InpTP1Pips from 15.0 to 20.0 pips eliminate the payout asymmetry observed in baseline EXP-0040, shifting 2020-2024 training net profit from -$800.31 to positive (> $0.00) while maintaining win rate >= 55% and drawdown <= 8.0%?
hypothesis: Because baseline EXP-0040 suffered negative net profit (-$800.31) despite a 66.2% win rate due to closing 50% of the position at only 15 pips (net +7.5 pips) against a full 15-pip stop loss (-15.0 pips), extending InpTP1Pips to 20.0 pips will increase the partial reward to +10.0 pips and allow momentum to carry runners further, shifting mathematical expectancy from negative to positive across 2020-2024 training data.

facts: EXP-0040 on AUDUSD M30 recorded 68 trades, a 66.18% win rate (45 wins, 23 losses), and a 21-trade consecutive win streak.
Despite the 66.2% win rate, EXP-0040 produced -$800.31 net profit and a profit factor of 0.55.
In EXP-0040, average win was $21.79 while average loss was -$77.42 (a 1:3.55 payout deficit).
Closing 50% of position volume at 15 pips awards only 7.5 pips of risk-adjusted profit, which is insufficient to overcome a 15-pip full position loss.
inferences: The failure of EXP-0040 was caused by structural payout asymmetry, not a lack of directional entry edge.
Extending TP1 to 20.0 pips increases the realized profit of the scaled-out volume by 33.3% (+10.0 pips net gain).
A 20-pip move confirms stronger intraday directional escape from the entry zone, improving trailing runner follow-through.
evidence: EXP-0040 total_trades=68, profit_factor=0.55, win_rate=66.18%, total_net_profit=-800.31, gross_profit=980.40, gross_loss=-1780.71, equity_drawdown_maximal_percent=8.88

independent_variables.name: InpTP1Pips
independent_variables.rationale: Increase initial scale-out reward from 7.5 pips to 10.0 pips effective per trade to restore positive mathematical expectancy.

assumptions: AUDUSD M30 swings of 18 pips regularly generate intraday continuation moves of at least 20 pips.
Holding trades an extra 5 pips to reach TP1 will not drastically reduce win rate below 55%.
expected_observations: Total net profit turns positive (> $0.00) across 2020-2024 training.
Average win per trade increases from $21.79 to >= $32.00.
falsification_conditions: Total net profit remains negative (< $0.00) or profit factor remains < 1.0.
Win rate drops below 50.0% due to price reversing before reaching the 20-pip target.
Total trade count collapses by > 40% (to < 40 trades) across the 5-year training period.
